info.title: Open Brewery DB Universal API
info.description: Open Brewery DB is a free public dataset and REST API for brewery, cidery, brewpub, and bottleshop information.

get.description: Retrieves a brewery from Open Brewery DB.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique Open Brewery DB brewery identifier.

schema.description: Unique Open Brewery DB brewery identifier.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

get.description: Retrieves brewery metadata from Open Brewery DB.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: byCity
parameters.description: Filter brewery metadata by city. Use underscores or URL encoding for spaces.

schema.description: Filter brewery metadata by city. Use underscores or URL encoding for spaces.

parameters.name: byCountry
parameters.description: Filter brewery metadata by country. Use underscores or URL encoding for spaces.

schema.description: Filter brewery metadata by country. Use underscores or URL encoding for spaces.

parameters.name: byName
parameters.description: Filter brewery metadata by name. Use underscores or URL encoding for spaces.

schema.description: Filter brewery metadata by name. Use underscores or URL encoding for spaces.

parameters.name: byState
parameters.description: Filter brewery metadata by full state name; abbreviations are not supported.

schema.description: Filter brewery metadata by full state name; abbreviations are not supported.

parameters.name: byPostal
parameters.description: Filter brewery metadata by postal or ZIP code. Postal+4 may use a hyphen or underscore.

schema.description: Filter brewery metadata by postal or ZIP code. Postal+4 may use a hyphen or underscore.

parameters.name: byType
parameters.description: Filter metadata by brewery type: micro, nano, regional, brewpub, large, planning, bar, contract, proprietor, or closed.

schema.description: Filter metadata by brewery type: micro, nano, regional, brewpub, large, planning, bar, contract, proprietor, or closed.

parameters.name: byDistance
parameters.description: Sort/filter metadata by distance from an origin point in latitude,longitude format.

schema.description: Sort/filter metadata by distance from an origin point in latitude,longitude format.

parameters.name: byIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of brewery IDs for metadata filtering.

schema.description: Comma-separated list of brewery IDs for metadata filtering. Pass multiple values separated by `,`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

by_state.description: Counts grouped by state or province.

total.description: Total number of breweries matching the filters.
